notes.title: 😼THE END of Early Access - Catnight 1.0 is here😼
notes.notes:
Santa Claus came a little early this year and brought you the long-awaited update.

We can proudly announce that we are putting the early access stage behind us. See for yourself how much Catnight has changed and improved.
[previewyoutube=KA0fIPtkh64;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What is new?[/b]

The promised [b]PvE[/b] is ready and smoking hot. You don’t need to assemble the crew (but of course you still can) to finally smash our dreadful opponents alone!
[previewyoutube=fWfLmg0Hs4k;full][/previewyoutube]
Try the [b]new modes[/b] and beat the swarming enemies. Yes, we have a zombie cucumber, how creepy is that?
[previewyoutube=xU8pHnWA4is;full][/previewyoutube]
Discover the completely [b]new level[/b] – Spooky Swamp with its beautiful nature and dangerous inhabitants.
[previewyoutube=52gHLOibpsA;full][/previewyoutube]
The new level, modes, menu, UI, and skins are waiting for you. So Merry Christmas! Don’t waste your time and try it out.
[previewyoutube=4h-d6KHJqHY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 😼Smashcat your enemies😼- play with Devs
notes.notes:
[h3]February's Next Fest is on, so are our kitties![/h3]

[h3][b]The livestream play session of the [b]Catnight[/b] game will be held on Wednesday, February 23st at 10:00pm CET[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=ZaVB_Jvj_Hk;full][/previewyoutube]

The development team will be on hand to answer your questions and give you an insight into the game. Join us and tell us what you think. Help us improve the game. 

 😻[b]About Catnight[/b]😻   

[b]Catnight[/b] is an online multiplayer third-person perspective game that will heat up any party. You will not only fight with your opponents and the enormous amount of furry bullets in the air, but you will also need to survive special gameplay circumstances, which will make every match more dynamic and funnier.
